utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, hope it gets sorted soon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it's this Saturday at the community center — everyone's bringing busted tools to fix up together!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: This Saturday? Right, I might be around — depends on the yard work, though.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Faye, just a heads up—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, thanks Rosa! I was wondering about the time—so it's Sunday at the community center now, got it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, glad you got the update! I'll send out a reminder to everyone later today.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! Yes, I think we talked about that. Let me just... uh, did we decide on a time?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I think Gus mentioned Saturday morning, but I'm not sure if that's set in stone yet.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday morning... right, I'll put that in my calendar. Now, where did I put those spare screws?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Noah! I just heard about the repair drive next Saturday — are you thinking of joining?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I think I remember Mara mentioning something about that. What time does it start again?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I'm not sure of the exact time yet, but I can check with Hana — she's the main organizer!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, this Saturday at the community center! Bring any broken items you'd like fixed, and I'll be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that's great news! I'll finally get that old toaster looked at.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, bring it along! I've got a box of spare toaster parts that might come in handy.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh hey Leo! Have you caught wind of the repair drive this Saturday? We could really use a hand!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I heard. Sam's offering tools, and Gus is bringing a drill. What time Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, sounds like we're getting a solid crew together! The drive kicks off at 9 a.m. in the community center parking lot—hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey everyone, sorry I'm late. Did I miss anything on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Nothing much, Dane. Rosa suggested Saturday morning, but nothing's set yet.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ah, Saturday morning works for me. Just let me know if we need extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Nell, aren't you excited about the repair drive? I heard they're collecting tools to fix up the community center—Eli's even donating some old hammers!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I've been hearing bits and pieces! Vik mentioned it's for community tools, and Opal thought she saw the setup near the old oak tree. Sounds like it's really coming together.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, it's shaping up nicely! I'm helping organize the donations, and Sam's already volunteered to lend a hand and some tools too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you talk to Pia about the scheduling yet, or are we still just guessing at times?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Haven't caught up with Pia yet, but I'll swing by her place this afternoon and nail down a time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, let me know what time we're all set for.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, you mean the Henderson's repair drive? Yeah, I heard about that. I've got some old tools to donate, they're picking them up Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Henderson's repair drive? I'm still trying to pin down the details — can you tell me what exactly they're fixing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: They're fixing up the community center, from what I gather. Need old tools, and they're coming by Saturday morning to collect mine.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What's this repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's a neighborhood event this Saturday where we fix broken items together—I've been gathering spare parts for it. Did you need something repaired?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I don't have anything broken right now, but I'll come by to lend a hand or just watch.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm fairly certain the repair drive moved to the shed behind Bo's house, but I'm not 100% sure it's still there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're talking about the same drive that group organized? Have you actually seen it there yourself, or is this just what someone told you?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I actually saw someone carrying tools in that direction yesterday, but I didn't go close enough to confirm it was the repair drive itself.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Vik, are you helping with the repair drive this Saturday too?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I'm all in! It's this Saturday at the community center, and everyone's bringing their busted tools to fix up together.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good to know. I'll be there to lend a hand with any clock repairs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I heard something about that—hope it gets sorted soon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Bo, sorry I'm late to the chat—did I miss any updates on the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, I think it's in the shed, but you might want to double-check.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do you have any actual documentation from the city about the repair schedule, Noah? I'm not buying vague promises.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Documentation? Uh, I think I might've seen a flyer somewhere... maybe on the community board? Honestly, I lose track of these things.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A flyer that you maybe saw? That's not exactly proof, Noah. I'd need a copy in hand before I start planning my day around it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think we should set up a shared schedule before anyone grabs a shovel—otherwise, we'll have chaos on the curb.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, a schedule would help keep things organized. Do you know if the repair drive is still behind Bo's shed or did it move to the oak tree by the park?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I heard it was by the oak tree, but I'm not 100% sure—let's double-check before we commit to a spot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Sam, I've been hearing bits about that repair drive too. Any solid news on when it's coming?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'm not sure on the exact date yet, Ira—I've just been offering my tools and help to whoever's organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Well, if anything solid comes your way, let me know—I'm happy to lend a hand too if they need it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rosa, I'm glad I caught you—I've got a solid stash of spare parts and tools ready for Saturday's repair drive. Are we still on?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Cleo, that's wonderful, but I need to let you know we've moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Sunday works for me! I'll make sure my stash is sorted and ready to go by then.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm still trying to figure out what this repair drive is all about. Does anyone have a clear list of items needed?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Hana! I've been hustling around gathering details. So far, we need basic tools like hammers and screwdrivers, plus paint and lumber for the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks Quinn, that's helpful. Do you know who decided on those items, or is there a written list I can look over?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Gus, have you heard anything more about that repair drive? I keep getting snippets from folks but can't pin down the full story.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Still waiting to hear back, Nell. Soon as I get a date, I'll post it on the community board and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Alright Gus, I'll keep an eye out for that board. Thanks for keeping me in the loop!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Eli, are you planning to come to the repair drive next Saturday? I've been rounding up some folks from the book club to help out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I've got some hammers and wrenches I can bring, but they need to be picked up by Saturday afternoon. Is that when the drive starts?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, the drive runs all day Saturday, so bringing them by in the afternoon works perfectly. I can swing by and grab them if you need me to!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Leo, I was just talking to Sam about the repair drive—did you know they're collecting tools for the community center this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'm setting up a repair station with Gus on Saturday. Need any specific tools?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's great you're getting involved! I think they're especially short on screwdrivers and drill bits, if you've got any extras.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I was just about to ask you the same thing — no confirmed time yet, but I can send out a message to nail one down.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, a message! I'll keep an eye out for it — though knowing me, I might forget to check my phone.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No worries, I can knock on your door if you'd like — just let me know!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Mina! Don't forget about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center. Bring any broken items you'd like fixed!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, is everyone actually coordinating the repair times, or are we just hoping nobody shows up at the same spot?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, we've got it all set! I'll be there from 10 to 4, and folks can come anytime—we'll manage things as they come in.
